form.label: Requirement Explorer
form.description: Explore requirements, evidence expectations, and implementation guidance.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected_value=tostring(coalesce(selected,default_selected)), selected=if(selected_value="1" OR selected_value="true",1,0) | search status=active selected=1 | fields framework_key framework_name
| inputlookup requirements.csv | search framework_key="$framework_token$" | dedup category | sort category | fields category

div.span: Framework: choose this first; categories and requirements are rebuilt from the selection. i
Category: categories belong to the selected framework. i
How to prove it: document means a policy or record, Splunk means measurable telemetry, and hybrid requires both. i

html.div: How to use this page: choose a framework, narrow the category if needed, then open a check. Each check explains what to implement, how to validate it, and what evidence an auditor should expect.

search.query: | inputlookup requirements.csv | search framework_key="$framework_token$" | search category="$category_token$" OR "$category_token$"="*" | search verification_mode="$verification_token$" OR "$verification_token$"="*" | lookup policy_playbook.csv framework_key requirement_key OUTPUT implementation_title implementation_steps validation_method owner_role common_gap | lookup framework_assessment_profiles.csv framework_key OUTPUT assessment_granularity assessment_methods scoring_model required_artifacts audit_boundary authority_statement | table framework_name requirement_key title requirement_type verification_label verification_guidance description evidence_types implementation_title implementation_steps validation_method owner_role common_gap source_reference assessment_granularity assessment_methods scoring_model required_artifacts audit_boundary authority_statement | rename framework_name as Framework title as Requirement requirement_type as Type verification_label as "How to prove it" verification_guidance as "Verification guidance" description as Description evidence_types as "Evidence expected" implementation_title as "Implementation" implementation_steps as "Implementation steps" validation_method as "How to validate" owner_role as "Suggested owner" common_gap as "Common gap" source_reference as "Source reference" assessment_granularity as "Assessment level" assessment_methods as "Assessment methods" scoring_model as "Decision model" required_artifacts as "Artifacts expected" audit_boundary as "Audit boundary" authority_statement as "Content status" | transpose | rename column as " ", "row *" as " *"

| inputlookup requirements.csv | search framework_key="$framework_token$" | search category="$category_token$" OR "$category_token$"="*" | search verification_mode="$verification_token$" OR "$verification_token$"="*" | table framework_key requirement_key framework_name title verification_label | rename framework_name as Framework title as Requirement verification_label as "How to prove it"

table.option: Click any requirement row to open its Check Detail view.
